svg.title: Which way to use. If you need dates, patterns or custom rules, or want to switch providers easily, use Way 2, check and retry: it works with almost any provider and every Pydantic check, but count your retries, because each is a full request. Otherwise start with Way 1, where the AI company enforces the form: a few extra lines, but tied to one provider and only part of JSON.
